item.title: Debloat Your Android Without Root Using Shizuku and Canta
item.description:
Debloat Your Android Without Root Using Shizuku and Canta

Modern Android phones often come with pre-installed applications that many users never use. These apps, commonly called bloatware, can consume storage, run background services, display unwanted notifications, and reduce battery life.

Fortunately, you no longer need to root your phone or connect it to a computer every time you want to remove unnecessary apps. Thanks to Shizuku and Canta, you can safely uninstall or disable many system applications directly from your phone.

item.title: Building an Autonomous Mobile & Desktop Document Processing AI Agent with OpenClaw
item.description:
Setting up a self-hosted AI agent that does more than just chat opens up incredible automation possibilities. By combining an open-source agentic framework with lightweight system utilities, you can turn a low-power phone or a modest desktop into a 24/7 personal document processing hub.

This guide walks through configuring OpenClaw (formerly known as Clawdbot) across Android Termux and Linux Mint, setting up messaging channel integrations, running local LLMs, and defining custom Markdown skills to automatically clean, compress, and OCR scanned office documents.

item.title: The Ultimate Guide: How to Set Up Free Remote Desktop for Windows 11 and Android
item.description:
The Ultimate Guide: How to Set Up Free Remote Desktop for Windows 11 and Android

Whether you need to grab a forgotten file, run heavy desktop software from your couch, or help a family member troubleshoot their PC, having remote access to your Windows 11 machine from your Android phone is an absolute game-changer.

Gone are the days when you had to pay hefty subscription fees for basic remote access. Today, there are several powerful, completely free tools that bridge the gap between your mobile device and your PC.

item.title: The Ultimate Indian Traveler’s Guide to eSIMs, Dual SIM Setups, and International Travel
item.description:
Navigating foreign connectivity while keeping your primary home numbers active can feel like a complex puzzle. Between Jio, Airtel, local international SIMs, physical SIM slots, and digital eSIM profiles, it is easy to get confused about what stays on, what gets turned off, and what actually needs to be physically swapped.

This complete guide breaks down everything you need to know about switching your Indian mobile lines (Jio and Airtel) to eSIM, configuring dual SIM settings for overseas travel, and managing a 3-SIM scenario on a single smartphone.
